Theme

Latin word

conjungō

conjungō, conjungere

verb, third conjugation

connect, join together; link, join together; join or unite; join together, unite

In this lexicon

  • connect

    the recommended word · classical

  • link

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.50: conjungitque nātūrālī quādam societāte

  • merge

    the recommended word · * our formation

  • unite

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fin. 3.71 (Lewis & Short, s.v. cōnsociō); Caes. B.C. 2.25 (Lewis & Short)

Notes

  1. 1Write consonantal i as j in all Latin, quotations included: jam, ejus, major, conjungō, Jōannēs. Ruling: Consonantal i is written j.

Examples

  • Fistulās inter sē conjungunt.

    They are connecting the tubes together.composed

    In the entry for connect

  • Praepositiōnēs cum verbīs compōnī possunt.

    Prepositions can be combined with verbs.Traupman 294

    at a time when the parts of a man did not all agree as one, as now, but each limb had its own mind and its own voiceLiv. 2.32.9
